blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A station of the North-South Commuter Railway (NSCR) in Clark, Pampanga, is now 73.29% complete, the Department of Transportation (DOTr) said. DOTr Undersecretary for Railways Timothy John Batan expressed confidence that the first partial operations of the NSCR extension project will begin by December 2027. According to the DOTr, the construction of the Clark Station was 73.29% complete as of September 2026.
